# StakeMap

> StakeMap is the map of Solana stake: it shows which stake pools, delegation programs and known stakeholders stake on which validators, epoch by epoch. The data comes straight from the chain and is open, with a public JSON API. Built and run by CryptoVik - independent Solana validator since 2021, open-source builder, on-chain researcher.

## What it shows

- Pools: every stake pool, liquid staking token, delegation program, DeFi protocol, exchange pool, private pool and large known stakeholder in a curated registry, with the validators each one stakes on.
- Validators: every validator seen since epoch 820, active or gone, with who stakes on it, how that changed epoch by epoch, and a log of name, identity, commission and client changes.
- Freshness: live data is refreshed continuously throughout the epoch; complete snapshots are archived several times per epoch and at every epoch boundary.
- History: since epoch 820 (July 2025), growing every epoch.
- Method: on-chain data read through RPC and matched to the registry. No third-party aggregator in between.

## Links

- App: https://stakemap.info/
- A pool or a program: https://stakemap.info/?pool=GROUP (GROUP is the "group" column of the registry, for example JITO_POOL)
- A validator: https://stakemap.info/?validator=VOTE_ACCOUNT (an identity key works too)
- A past epoch: add &epoch=N to either link
- Validators list: https://stakemap.info/?tab=validators
- Documentation inside the app: https://stakemap.info/?tab=docs

## Data API

Base: https://data.stakemap.info/v1/ (additive versioning: /v1/ keeps working). The same files are also served from https://data.cryptovik.info/v1/, the earlier address.

- Live snapshot of the current epoch: https://data.stakemap.info/v1/mainnet-beta/live.json
- Health and freshness of the pipeline: https://data.stakemap.info/v1/mainnet-beta/status.json
- Manifest of archived epoch snapshots: https://data.stakemap.info/v1/mainnet-beta/manifest.json
- Per-epoch history of every pool: https://data.stakemap.info/v1/mainnet-beta/aggregated-history.json
- Index of validators: https://data.stakemap.info/v1/mainnet-beta/validators/index.json
- History of one validator: https://data.stakemap.info/v1/mainnet-beta/validators/VOTE_ACCOUNT.json
- Registry of pools, programs and stakeholders (CSV): https://data.stakemap.info/v1/registry/stakepools_list.csv
- API reference with field descriptions and examples: https://github.com/SOFZP/Solana-Stake-Pools-Research/blob/main/DATA_API.md
- How the pipeline works: https://github.com/SOFZP/Solana-Stake-Pools-Research/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Dataset repository with every archived snapshot: https://github.com/SOFZP/Solana-Stake-Pools-Research
